canonical_project: BASS d.o.o. Celje network / hosting data-center-class ASN
notes: Weak facility evidence: IP2Location ASN metadata classifies AS197579 Bass d.o.o. Celje as Data Center/Web Hosting/Transit, and the Slovenian IT Infrastructure & Data Center Section lists BASS d.o.o., Celje as a member. BASS official site confirms the Celje software/IT company presence, but no public MW capacity or named physical data-center facility was found.
